answer: Give every candidate one numbered community-garden pot and a randomly selected seed batch tagged with the relic/ripple/garden nonce. A coordinator logs planting against that pot ID and checks a time-stamped germination photo after seven days; the registry consumes the pot-season pair and rejects duplicate IDs, stale photos or a missing growth check. Proposed garden-audit fee is .40 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .40 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,400 (1,000 × .40). Limitation: germination varies by season and coordinators can collude.
